files.list.title: List files
files.list.description: Page through the caller's side's files; the keyword matches the original name, stored name, extension, content type and tags.
files.get.title: Get file
files.update.title: Edit file details
files.update.description: Edit a file's access level, temporary flag and expiry, tags and remark.
files.set_status.title: Archive or restore files
files.set_status.description: Archive or restore files in a batch; corrupted files are rejected one by one.
files.delete.title: Delete files
files.delete.description: Delete files in a batch; stored content goes once no other file uses it.
files.presign.title: Get signed download link
files.presign.description: Obtain a signed download link: files open to signed-in users need only a sign-in, files that need authorization require files.files.read; the link is not checked against an identity while it is valid.
files.fast_upload.title: Instant upload
files.fast_upload.description: Instant upload: when a normal file with the same content already exists on the caller's side, a new record is created at once; a miss returns nothing.
files.storages.title: List file copies
files.storages.description: List a file's stored copies, primary copy first.
files.set_primary_storage.title: Set primary copy
files.set_primary_storage.description: Make a normal, verified copy the primary copy; a corrupted file becomes normal again.
files.verify_storage.title: Verify copy
files.verify_storage.description: Verify a copy by reading it and comparing its SHA-256; a mismatch or missing content marks it failed, and a failed primary copy marks the file corrupted.
files.set_storage_status.title: Enable or disable copy
files.set_storage_status.description: Enable or disable a copy; the primary copy cannot be disabled and a failed copy must be verified again.
storage_configs.list.title: List storage configurations
storage_configs.list.description: Page through the caller's side's storage configurations, default first; access keys are never shown.
storage_configs.get.title: Get storage configuration
storage_configs.get.description: Get a storage configuration (the access key is never shown).
storage_configs.create.title: Create storage configuration
storage_configs.create.description: Create a local or S3-compatible storage configuration on the caller's side; the code is unique on the side and S3-compatible storage needs an endpoint and access keys.
storage_configs.update.title: Edit storage configuration
storage_configs.update.description: Edit a storage configuration (the code stays; an empty access key keeps the current one).
storage_configs.set_status.title: Enable or disable storage configuration
storage_configs.set_status.description: Enable or disable a storage configuration; the default one cannot be disabled.
storage_configs.set_default.title: Set default storage configuration
storage_configs.set_default.description: Make an enabled storage configuration the caller's side's default; later uploads go there.
storage_configs.delete.title: Delete storage configurations
storage_configs.delete.description: Delete storage configurations in a batch; the default one and those holding copies are rejected one by one.

files.storage_config.bucket_invalid: The bucket name {bucket} is invalid: use 3 to 63 lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
files.storage_config.remote_required: {type} storage needs an endpoint, an access key ID and an access key.
files.storage_config.endpoint_invalid: The endpoint {endpoint} is not an absolute http or https address.
files.file.too_large: The file exceeds the size limit of {max} bytes.
files.file.empty: No file was received, or the file is empty or has no name.
files.file.hash_invalid: The SHA-256 must be 64 hexadecimal characters.
files.link.lifetime_invalid: The link lifetime must be between {min} and {max} seconds.
files.file.status_invalid: A file can only be set to normal or archived: {status}
files.file_storage.status_invalid: A copy can only be set to normal or unavailable: {status}
files.storage_config.code_taken: The storage configuration code {code} already exists.
files.storage_config.default_locked: The default storage configuration cannot be disabled or deleted; make another one the default first.
files.storage_config.in_use: The storage configuration still holds {count} file copies and cannot be deleted.
files.file_storage.not_usable: This copy cannot be the primary copy: it must be normal and verified; verify a failed copy again first.
files.file_storage.primary_locked: The primary copy cannot be disabled; make another copy primary first.
files.file.unavailable: The file is {status}; its content cannot be read.
files.storage_config.default_needs_activ: A disabled storage configuration cannot be the default.
files.file.access_denied: This file requires files.files.read to download.
files.storage.none: Neither the caller's side nor the platform has a usable default storage configuration.
files.storage_config.undecryptable: The access key of storage configuration {code} cannot be decrypted (the data protection key ring may have changed); enter the access key again.
export_tasks.submit.title: Submit export
export_tasks.submit.description: Submit an export: run a list operation's query as yourself in the background and write CSV or XLSX, kept as a temporary file for 7 days. The list operation checks its own permission as usual.
export_tasks.list.title: List export tasks
export_tasks.list.description: Page through your own export tasks.
export_tasks.get.title: Get export task
export_tasks.get.description: Get one of your export tasks.
export_tasks.cancel.title: Cancel export task
export_tasks.cancel.description: Cancel one of your queued export tasks.
export_tasks.delete.title: Delete export tasks
export_tasks.delete.description: Delete your export tasks together with their result files; running ones are rejected one by one.
import_histories.create.title: Record import result
import_histories.create.description: Record the result of an import (the page creates the rows one by one).
import_histories.recent.title: List recent imports
import_histories.recent.description: List your most recent imports on a page.
files.export.target_invalid: {businessType} is not a list operation that can be exported.
files.export.columns_required: Choose at least one column to export.
files.export.query_invalid: The query snapshot must be a JSON object.
files.export.not_pending: The export task is {status}; only queued tasks can be cancelled and running tasks cannot be deleted.
files.export.credential_missing: This call carries no sign-in credential, so the export cannot run in the background as you.
openapi.tags.files.name: Files
openapi.tags.files.description: Upload and download files, instant upload and signed download links, metadata, archiving and deletion, and managing and verifying stored copies.
openapi.tags.storage_configs.name: Storage configurations
openapi.tags.storage_configs.description: Create, read, update and delete local and S3-compatible storage configurations, enable or disable them and pick the default.
openapi.tags.export_tasks.name: Export tasks
openapi.tags.export_tasks.description: Background exports for the export center: submit, view, cancel and delete your own export tasks.
openapi.tags.import_histories.name: Import history
openapi.tags.import_histories.descriptio: Record import results and view your recent imports on each page.
openapi.groups.files.name: Files and storage
openapi.groups.files.description: File access and stored copies, storage configurations, the export center and import history.
